notes: requires: host capabilities the skill needs to function — a platform not listing one of these makes render-adapters.mjs BLOCK (Test G). forbidden_capabilities: capabilities the skill/task must never actually USE — enforced by eligibility.mjs against task.capabilitiesUsed, not against what the host merely has available (host has capability != skill is using capability). The field was previously named requires_not; scripts/load-compatibility.mjs accepts either name for backward compatibility but new entries should use forbidden_capabilities.
